# raff_api_key (Resource)

Creates a Raff API key. The plaintext secret is returned ONCE at create time and stored in the secret attribute (sensitive). Lock down your Terraform state — anyone with read access to it can use the key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration in RFC3339 (e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z). Omit for never-expires.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the key is active. Set to false to suspend without revoking.
- `rate_limit_tier` (String) standard (default, 30 RPS) or high (100 RPS, requires support approval).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_prefix` (String) First 13 characters of the key (e.g. raff_pub_17d70fcf).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Full plaintext API key. Returned only once on create or regenerate; never re-fetchable.
